title: White Rabbit: poisoned pipeline execution
description: A Jenkins controller builds the Wonderland/white-rabbit repository from Gitea on every branch and pull request, and its release token is a Global-scope credential any pipeline can read. With write access to the repository, poison its Jenkinsfile to exfiltrate the token (OWASP CICD-SEC-4, Direct Poisoned Pipeline Execution).
question: Submit the value of the flag1 credential, exfiltrated by poisoning the white-rabbit Jenkinsfile, exactly as recovered.
